purpose: Measure, but do not launch, the cost basis for a possible R96 validation.
trigger: Run one R96 M1 ten-step benchmark only if R48 changes the dominant physical wavelength by more than 10 percent, changes the top-three mode ordering, or leaves the dominant wavelength below 12 cells.
admission_use: Extrapolate 4800-step solver cost and conservatively scale measured R48 post/archive cost by two. This is a planning estimate, not authorization for a full R96 pair.
forbidden: No R96 long run, R96 M0, multiwave, or 8T run is authorized by this trigger.
